This limitation is disclosed and does not require rereading the raw member.
reviewed_conclusions.budget: Protocol retains the 20 remaining new-member reads and the previously pinned cache reuse; no cap expansion or raw data access occurred in this review.
reviewed_conclusions.scientific_limit: Accepted values remain sampled-signal consistent only. Absolute calibration and exact hardware cutoff are unknown; whole-life first-passage EOL and native-cycle RUL remain blocked while inter-file continuity is unverified.

conclusion: The added receipt and cache-member binding checks resolve the prior v2 provenance blocker for this pre-GO review. No reconstruction result or capacity asset was produced by the review.
